items.question: Can I edit the text on the generated thumbnail?
items.answer: Yes! Lovart's 'Text Edit' feature allows you to directly click and edit any text on the generated image, ensuring your title is perfect and typo-free.

items.question: Does Lovart support the correct YouTube aspect ratio?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can select the 16:9 aspect ratio (1920x1080) specifically for YouTube thumbnails, ensuring a perfect fit without cropping.

items.question: Can I use my own face in the thumbnails?
items.answer: Yes. You can upload a reference photo of yourself, and our Agent can generate thumbnails that maintain your facial features while placing you in new scenarios.

items.question: Are the images copyright-free?
items.answer: Yes, all thumbnails generated on paid plans come with a commercial license, so you can monetize your YouTube videos without worry.

items.question: How do I make my thumbnail look 'clicky'?
items.answer: Use prompts that ask for 'high contrast,' 'expressive emotion,' and 'bold colors.' Our Agent is trained on high-performing design patterns to maximize CTR.
